question: Should the first shipped quota-planning surface expose the learned “Available full sessions” estimate for Codex, Claude, and Antigravity together, or should it be narrowed to the Codex user workflow before expanding provider support?
rationale: The implementation creates a new cross-provider user-facing metric and the associated design document is still an open draft; source review can validate mechanics but cannot establish the desired permanent product contract or rollout scope.

options.title: Ship a Codex-first rollout
options.body: Approve Codex as the initial supported provider after the correctness repairs and proof, while keeping the descriptor infrastructure internal until other provider semantics are explicitly accepted.

options.title: Approve all three providers
options.body: Accept Codex, Claude, and Antigravity as the supported initial contract and require representative redacted proof for each provider path.

options.title: Pause for design closure
options.body: Keep the implementation draft until the design discussion resolves the supported-provider and metric-contract scope.

recommendation.title: Ship a Codex-first rollout
recommendation.body: Approve Codex as the initial supported provider after the correctness repairs and proof, while keeping the descriptor infrastructure internal until other provider semantics are explicitly accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: The related request and design draft identify maintainer product direction as the unresolved decision point.
